english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who refuses to change their opinion or behaviour.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone stubbornly refuses to change their mind or follow others.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone obstinately refuses to change or admit they are wrong.
Use this when “wayward” mainly stresses obstinacy or refusal to change, rather than straying from expectations.

examples.english: They are really stubborn; no matter how much we advise them, they refuse to change.
examples.traditional: 佢真係好固執，點勸都唔肯改。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gu3 zap1 dim2 hyun3 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2

examples.english: He is so headstrong that he refuses to change the plan no matter how much everyone advises him.
examples.traditional: 佢固執到咁，大家點勸佢都唔肯改個計劃。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gu3 zap1 dou3 gam3 daai6 gaa1 dim2 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2 go3 gai3 waak6

examples.english: You know you were wrong, but you’re still so perverse and refuse to admit it.
examples.traditional: 你明知自己做錯咗都仲咁固執，死口唔認。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ming4 zi1 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 zo2 dou1 zung6 gam3 gu3 zap1 sei2 hau2 m4 jing6

examples.english: You are so wayward that you refuse to change no matter how much everyone advises you.
